item.title: WATCH: Mayor Mamdani And NYPD Commissioner Speak Outside 770 Following Ramming Attack
item.description: NYC Mayor Mamdani and NYPD Commissioner Jessica Tisch spoke outside Chabad World Headquarters at 770 Eastern Parkway following Wednesday night’s car-ramming incident. Mayor Mamdani noted that today marks the yahrtzeit of the sixth Lubavitcher Rebbe, Harav Yosef Yitzchak Schneersohn, zt”l.
